title: Mobile/touch visual canary for configurable Habits
mission: Exercise the isolated configurable-Habits candidate on a representative mobile/touch JavaScript surface without changing Current, Human Accepted or Served. Verify that the configurable tracker controls, Habits timeline, Calendar iframe and Money surface remain usable and visually intact at small viewport sizes, including touch targets, scrolling, dialogs and mode switching.
definition_of_done: The isolated candidate renders at a representative mobile viewport without clipping, overlap, dead controls or accidental horizontal page overflow.
Touch can switch Calendar/Habits/Money and operate tracker configuration controls without dead zones or unintended activation.
Habits timeline/range navigation remains usable and the configurable tracker UI does not obscure or break existing traces.
Money editor and Calendar surface remain reachable and behaviorally intact at the same viewport.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served, Catalog or production pointer is changed.
Exact viewport/device/browser observations and screenshots or equivalent rendered evidence are persisted.
